title: Pixel Art Class - Simple Character Idle Animation
description:
Heya Pals!

I've got a brief video for you today covering my approach to more subtle animations like idles without detailed draft layers. Here we're just looking at single pose idle frames with sub-pixel adjustments.

More on sub pixel animation from me: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cs1Gp61yafQ

More on my Aseprite export scripts: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hiMBVCFMj6E

Chapters:
0:00 - Introduction
0:34 - Setup
4:56 - Core Frames
6:30 - Chest Sub-pixel Animation
10:12 - Arms Secondary Motion
12:02 - Hair Secondary Motion
14:08 - Sub-pixel Shading
15:19 - Preparing for Export
17:17 - Wrap Up
17:37 - Outro
